story_text: In 1957, A.I. Ortenburger (Sam Noble Oklahoma Museum of Natural History, 29149) reported this taxon of colubrid snakes, which was later confirmed by Jessica Kirkwood in 2019.
In 1979, Geoffrey G.E. Scudder (UBC, H001463) reported this taxon of newts, which was later confirmed by Shera Street in 2007.

story_text: In 1957, A.I. Ortenburger (Sam Noble Oklahoma Museum of Natural History., 27613) reported this taxon of treefrogs, which was later confirmed by Ian Guthrie in 2008.
In 2010, Kent Brothers (VMS) reported this taxon of true frogs, which was later confirmed by Cameron Eckert in 2010.
In 2025, mandrews65 reported this taxon of wall lizards as new for Galiano Island.
